hotspots.suggestion: (AI Analysis) Opus is the most expensive model. Use only for truly complex reasoning tasks. For analysis, Claude Sonnet 3.5 or gpt-4o often provide similar quality at 3x lower cost. Test if downgrading maintains quality.

(AI Analysis) Streaming is implemented correctly. Consider Claude Haiku for simple streaming tasks at much lower cost, or self-hosted Llama-3.1-8B with vLLM for high-volume streaming workloads.
(AI Analysis) Excellent use of prompt caching! This can reduce costs by 90% for repeated context. Ensure cache hit rates are high. For non-cached portions, consider cheaper models.
(AI Analysis) Claude excels at tool use. For simpler tool calls, consider Claude Haiku or gpt-4o-mini. For complex multi-tool orchestration, Claude Sonnet is justified.

(AI Analysis) Claude Sonnet handles vision well. Compare with Gemini 1.5 Flash for vision tasks - often cheaper with similar quality. For high-volume image analysis, consider specialized vision models.
(AI Analysis) LangChain overhead + expensive model. Consider Claude Haiku or gpt-4o-mini for most chain operations. Reserve Sonnet for final reasoning steps only.
(AI Analysis) Routing pattern is good. Test if Claude Sonnet 3.5 or gpt-4o provide sufficient quality for complex queries at lower cost.
(AI Analysis) Fallback to expensive model. Consider cheaper fallback options: Claude Haiku or gpt-4o-mini as secondary, reserve Sonnet as third fallback only.
